stage_or_date: Forced-liquidation suit Nov 2025; declared bankrupt 5 Feb 2026
the_problem: Cheap Chinese competition collapsed the Chilean canning market per family representative Mario Consigliere; a creditor (Termodinámica Ingeniería y Servicios Industriales, owed over CLP 251 million) filed a forced-liquidation suit in Nov 2025, and the company was declared bankrupt with CLP 2,343 million owed to creditors (Banco Consorcio CLP 994 million).
the_decision: Mario Consigliere, representing the family that co-controls the company with the Bozzo family, told Pulso the firm would not shut down but would seek a reorganization process, telling its 110 staff about the situation, and would look to expand export markets, especially Asia. He blamed China: "La competencia de China es desastrosa y destruyó el mercado de los conserveros en Chile".
the_outcome: Declared bankrupt after 118 years with CLP 2,343 million in creditor commitments; 110 workers exposed; outcome of the reorganization attempt not yet known at publication.
